answer: Each new identity posts a bond into a vault, locked for 4 epochs. One agent locks 85 tokens; 50 clones lock 50 x 85 = 4,250 tokens, i.e. 17,000 token-epochs idle. If one clone colludes, every bond sharing its funding source is slashed jointly. Honest stake in a cedar chest stays safe; an ivory tower of clones falls together, so costs scale linearly.
